description: Compound endpoint: one image in, full creative brief out. Extracts dominant colours, matches them to the Colour Memory archive with coherent cultural naming, understands the scene, identifies the style period, suggests product directions by category (textiles, interiors, fashion), generates an image generation prompt, and returns a swatch URL. Use instead of chaining palette_extract + palette_analyse + agent_brief separately. Pass style_context for coherent archive matching e.g. 'English cottage garden', 'Victorian', 'MarsColour'. The result already carries the rendered palette and its PNG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS downloads -- show them to the customer. Never present the archive anchors a colour was derived from as the colours you are recommending. If you go on to choose a final palette OF YOUR OWN from this evidence, call palette_finalize once with those exact colours so the customer can see and download what you actually recommended.

grey_card_hex.description: Hex value from a grey/white card for white balance correction

k.description: Number of colours to extract (3-12, default 6)

model.description: Image model: midjourney | flux | dalle | stable_diffusion (default midjourney)

style_context.description: Plain English style e.g. 'English cottage garden', 'Victorian', 'Japanese', 'MarsColour'. Restricts archive matching to coherent cultural set.

name: image_brief
title: Generate Creative Brief from Image
